contract.structural_score_basis: The Ethereum sUSDe vault shares USDe's 24-hour TimelockController for full administration and cooldown changes. The same 5-of-10 Dev Safe is proposer and canceller, so there is no independent veto. The Safe also holds immediate but bounded restriction authority, while reward operations include a separate 3-of-10 Payout Fund Safe. The live cooldown is one day but governance can set up to the contract maximum of 90 days. Several OFT deployments use 24-hour owner timelocks; Blast and Fraxtal instead have direct undelayed 5-of-10 owners, so chain-local authority is disclosed separately rather than averaged away.

code_facts: Full Ethereum administration and cooldown changes pass through a 24-hour timelock.
The 5-of-10 Dev Safe is both proposer and canceller.
Immediate restriction authority is bounded but can affect specific holders.
The cooldown contract maximum is 90 days, not seven days.
